name: a runtime log shows the system working alone
looks: A short headline states that the company runs itself, beside a dark terminal-style panel where a list of task rows types on one at a time, each confirming it is running, with a running count of tasks and two numbers (a high automation share, a small human share) ticking beside it. A final row tags one task as waiting on a human sign-off.
build: DOM monospace rows revealed on a steady per-row beat, each with a status tag that resolves from 'queued' to 'running'; a small mono corner readout counts tasks and the two percentage values with no easing; the last row's status tag is visually distinct (a highlighted sign-off chip).
sound: A soft mechanical tick per row landing, a slightly brighter tone on the sign-off row.
prompt: Explain how the product runs without constant human input: a short claim beside a terminal-style log where task rows type on one by one, each confirming it's running, with a live counter nearby splitting the work between automation and a small human share, ending on the one row that still needs a person's sign-off.
